Read this first
This file answers the same 62 questions as the detailed report, in everyday words. You do not need to know planet names
to use it. Dates still matter. Astrology here is a map of patterns and timing, not a doctor's note and not a guarantee.
YOUR LIFE IN ONE PARAGRAPH
You are in a 7-year chapter of courage and career (August 2022 to August 2029). Right now, until February 2027, the
job is paperwork and honest talks. February to July 2027 is for endings, not big starts. July 2027 to September 2028 is
the harvest: marriage or a serious partnership, money with your name on it, and a public role. From August 2029 a
longer chapter of networks and bigger reach begins. The habit that can spoil all of this is starting something strong, then
quietly backing out.
A short dictionary
Life chapter = a multi-year period (here, the Mars chapter until 2029). Sub-chapter = a year or so inside it (you are in a
'documents and speech' sub-chapter until Feb 2027). Hard transit = a slow sky weather that adds delay and worry
(roughly 2025 to early 2028). When in doubt, follow the dates in the table later in this file.
A. Before you sit with an astrologer
1. Is my birth time accurate enough?
For the main life-map, 3:57 AM is good enough. Your rising sign would only change if the clock were about half an
hour wrong. The marriage-detail chart (a finer map) is more sensitive. If a future astrologer's picture of your spouse feels
totally unlike you, ask them to check the birth time first. The year-chapters used in this file are based on the Moon and
stay reliable even with a small time error.
2. Which system is this using?
Indian (Vedic) astrology with the usual Nepal/India sky correction, and whole-sign houses from Aquarius rising. When
something is uncertain, this file says so. A good astrologer should do the same instead of sounding sure about a shaky
point.
3. Which extra charts should they use?
The main birth chart plus the marriage/inner-self chart. For you, also ask for a career chart, because this decade is about
work with your name on it. Ask for a children chart only if that question is live. Extra charts should support the main
one, not replace common sense.
4. What is this chart not promising, so I can stop chasing it?
It is not promising: an easy life as the quiet helper in the back room forever; a shy partner who never challenges you;
quick money with no delay; many children on a family deadline; staying only in your birth city with no inner cost; a
personality that is only soft or only tough. It is promising: skill that becomes a name, a proud equal beside you, money
that arrives later and lasts, and work that may involve other countries or behind-the-scenes mastery.
B. How your chart is built
5. What matters most for the next 7 years?
This is a career-and-courage chapter. The payday inside it is July 2027 to September 2028: love/money/home and a
visible role. This year (until Feb 2027) is not the payday. It is the year you put things in writing so that payday can
happen.
6. Why do I want to lead and also want to hide?
One part of you is built to act, compete, and be seen. Another part is built to work privately, live at a distance, and avoid
the spotlight. The healthy version: do the deep work in private, then put your name on it. The unhealthy version: start,
then disappear, and call that 'being careful'.

7. When does the 'lucky' love-and-money planet actually pay me?
That planet was running in childhood (until 2006), so it shaped your taste and values more than your bank account. It
pays in adult life from 20 July 2027 to 18 September 2028. A second, bigger money-and-status wave comes around
2041-2044. Do not wait for the 2040s if 2027-28 is available.
8. Why do talks and documents go wrong first, then work?
Your communication-and-money planet is weak on the surface and strong underneath. So a contract, exam, visa, or
conversation often fails the first time and succeeds after one real correction. Until February 2027, expect that pattern.
Revise once, then file. Do not revise forever.
9. What does a strong Sun as marriage-ruler ask of me?
You win honour and a partner through your own effort, voice, and courage -- not by waiting to be picked. In marriage
you need respect. A bond that requires you to become small will not last.
10. Is marriage late, or do I marry after I grow up inside?
Both. The spouse-house is actually blessed: a partner with warmth, pride, and self-respect, often from a family that takes
itself seriously -- or a woman who carries that dignity herself. The delay is inner. You tend to look for a teacher in a
partner. You marry well after you have become, in private, the person you kept hoping someone else would be. That is
why 2027-28 is the clock.
11. What about children, romance, and risk-taking?
This area of the chart is thinner and more unusual: fewer children or later children, romance that does not follow the
family script, and bets that can cut as well as pay. From February to July 2027, do not force an engagement, a baby plan,
or a high-risk bet. That window is for ending false stories, not starting new ones.
12. What must I uproot before the bigger 2030s?
The habit of being useful and unnamed. Family roles that keep you the peacemaker instead of a person with a public
craft. Relationships where you manage someone else's life. The idea that more research will replace a decision. From
2029, a long 'bigger life' chapter begins. It will enlarge whatever you already are -- a ghost or a person with a name.
13. What does reading from the Moon add?
From the Moon, career also pays through other people's money, research, or shared resources -- consulting, healing,
foreign clients, not only a local job. The partner can feel like a missing piece of you, which is beautiful and dangerous:
you may dump your unlived self onto them. The 2025-2028 worry-weather is stronger from the Moon's point of view.
That is why this stretch feels heavier than the career chapter 'should'.
14. Which empty life-areas still matter, and which am I neglecting?
Home, daily work/health, in-laws and shared money, father/luck, and public reputation have no planet sitting in them --
but their rulers are active. The neglected one is reputation. You over-do service and under-claim credit. Your work is
meant to have your name on the door, not only on the unpaid extra.
C. Timing -- the part to reread
15. What is this year, until 21 February 2027, actually for?
Paperwork, talks, exams, visas, offers, and telling the truth. First 'no', then 'yes' after a correction. Watch nerves, sleep,
skin, and stomach. Do not treat the first rejection as the final answer. 13 Sep to 6 Nov 2026: look at unusual or foreign
options, but do not rush-sign. 6 Nov to 24 Dec 2026: best weeks to negotiate and put things in writing. Late Dec 2026 to
Feb 2027: finish and rest. Do not launch a company or a wedding.
16. What should I finish before Feb-Jul 2027, and what should I not start?
Finish: the contract, the portfolio, the health checkup, the overdue conversation, a savings buffer. If you must leave a
dead role, try to sign that in Nov-Dec 2026. Do not start: a wedding, a new company, a baby-as-plan, or a big borrowed
bet. You may feel destiny in early 2027. Treat it as a preview, not a stamp.

17. Is July 2027 to September 2028 really my best window?
Yes, for this decade -- for a serious relationship or marriage, money, home/vehicle, and a public professional face. You
can weaken it by marrying too early in 2027 out of impatience, by staying invisible, by choosing a partner with no spine,
or by ignoring your health until the body cannot hold the good luck. Fear itself does not cancel it.
18. Why does 2025-2028 still feel hard even in a 'career chapter'?
A slow, heavy sky-weather is sitting on worry, delays, family duty, and money that comes with strings. It charges a toll.
Pay it with sleep, honest accounts, and fewer secrets. It does not mean the career chapter failed. Until early 2027 there is
also restlessness about identity and foreign pulls. Do not emigrate, change your face, or take a medical shortcut on a
mood. Pick one name and keep it.
19. When the 'good luck' planet visits my marriage area, is that a feeling or an event?
Both, at different times. From late 2026 you may feel hope and start talks. The real event-window is when that visit
overlaps July 2027-September 2028: engagement, marriage, a business partner, or a serious upgrade of a current bond.
Do not book a hall in 2026 just because you feel ready.
20. What does August 2029 to May 2032 bring?
The first slice of a 18-year 'bigger reach' chapter: networks, foreign or unusual income, appetite for more. It is raw. It
multiplies what you already built in 2027-28. It is a poor time to invent a life from scratch because you felt behind.

These dates are the practical heart of the reading. If you remember nothing else, remember this table.
21. What is my 12-month plan from now?
The next 12 months are not a harvest. They are: a short decision (early September), a research pause (mid-September to
early November), a talking-and-writing block (November-December), then rest and cutting until July 2027. The real
push starts 20 July 2027.
22. Which year is not for marriage, property, or a company even if I feel ready?
21 February 2027 to 20 July 2027. Also: do not stamp a marriage in late 2026. Talks are fine. The stamp waits. 2030-31
can work only as a bigger version of something already begun, not as a first leap.
D. Work and money
23. Should I run my own named work, or stay employed?
Named work fits you better -- a practice, a studio, a consultancy, a small firm with your name. A job is fine if it leads to
real authority. A job where you do the work and someone else takes the credit will make you sick over time.

24. What kinds of work fit?
Work where skill, nerve, and a name matter: technical leadership, engineering, investigation, sports or training, crisis
work, surgery of systems (or bodies, if you train for it), starting things others then run. Also healing, teaching, writing,
short travel, sales of expertise. Money can come through voice and advice -- counselling, design, billed knowledge.
Later, foreign or online networks. Poor fit: empty prestige, a job whose only prize is being liked, and gambling as a
living.
25. When should I leave a job where I am needed but unnamed?
When the next thing exists on paper -- drafted now, lived from July 2027. Do not quit in a September/October 2026
mood with no structure. Do not stay forever out of loyalty. If they will not put your name on the work by the 2027-28
window, you put your name on your own work.
26. Should I take a business partner? Who would harm me?
Yes, a partner can open money -- but not in Feb-Jul 2027. Choose someone competent, proud, good at paperwork, with
their own life. Avoid someone you 'fix', someone who folds when you are intense, someone who only criticises, or
someone who uses your hidden labour. Write an exit clause. You may outgrow the first 'teacher' partner.
27. How do I make money, and when does it steady?
Through billed skill, speech, advice, and useful beauty -- not through looking rich. It will not fully steady while the
2025-early 2028 delay-weather lasts. It becomes more reliable from mid-2027, then bigger after 2029. Keep 6-12
months of expenses saved. That is structure, not fear.
28. Why does money feel slow?
Delay, then durability. Money leaks to family duty, distance, or hidden costs, then becomes solid. Slow is not 'you are
not meant to have it'. Slow means unsupervised money is not your friend. Keep accounts.
29. Will I earn from abroad, or actually live abroad?
The chart supports both. This career chapter can bring foreign clients or a stay away from home. The stronger 'settle or
scale abroad' chapter is from 2029. Choose a move as a plan, not as an escape.
30. Is this a lucky-windfall chart or a build-it chart?
Build-it. You are paid for a named craft. After 2029 a sudden network win can appear, but you still pay with an
uprooting. If an offer needs no skill and lots of secrecy, walk away. If it needs your name, your hours, and a contract, it
is yours.
E. Love and marriage
31. Is marriage actually in this chart?
Yes -- a real, visible partnership. A secret arrangement will not satisfy you. If your family needs a ceremony, 2027-28
supports one. If you reject marriage as an institution, you still need an equal, not a maybe.
32. Best time to marry, and the fake-fated time?
Best: 20 July 2027 to 18 September 2028. Second chance: September 2028 to January 2029. Fog: rushing in autumn
2026, or feeling 'this is destiny' from February to July 2027. That second patch is a preview. Marrying in 2026 to calm
anxiety is using a person as medicine.
33. What is my wife / spouse like, and how do we meet?
Warm, proud, not mousy. Self-respect. Possibly a family that takes itself seriously, or she carries that seriousness in
herself. Independent. May work in something brave, healing, or communicative. You meet through work, words, a
course, a short trip, or a sibling's circle -- not through hiding. She should feel like an equal, not a project and not a parent.

34. How will we fight, and who can handle me?
Fights will be about work, health, and whose will leads. You may go helpful-then-sharp, then silent, then guilty and
over-giving. You need someone with a spine who can say 'that was too much' without shaming you for having a will. A
yes-person will make you cruel. A pure critic will make you small.
35. Am I 'manglik'? Should I fear it?
Some traditional lists say Mars in the 1st house is a marriage warning. A common exception is Mars in Aquarius --
which you have -- so many astrologers say the label does not apply. Do not fear a curse. Do respect this: you bring heat
into close bonds. Match with someone who can meet heat, not with someone who is afraid of it.
36. What should I never do in love just to keep peace?
Do not swallow what you want and then punish them with silence, over-helpfulness, or a sudden exit. Do not become
their manager so you feel safe. Do not shrink so they will not call you 'too much'. Peace that needs you to vanish is not
peace.
37. If I already have someone, what should an astrologer check in their chart?
Can they meet your intensity without collapsing? Is their 2027-28 chapter also able to hold a bond? Bring both birth
times. Walk away from a match where you are only their escape, or where shared money has no dignity. Matching
without a birth time is guessing.
38. After marriage, when is the test, and what would break it?
Tests: 2029 (old fights about work and care), 2029-32 (hunger for a bigger life, travel, 'is this enough?'). What breaks it:
disappearing into work, competing with her pride, using the marriage to solve loneliness then resenting her. What holds
it: a shared project, sexual honesty, and clear household agreements.
F. Family, home, children
39. When do home, a vehicle, or land come?
Most likely with the 2027-28 harvest -- a deposit, a car, a title, or a serious renovation. The first stable base may be away
from your birth city. That still counts as home.
40. What is the family karma I should stop carrying?
The job of peacemaker and unpaid caretaker. Loyalty is good. Erasing yourself is not. Leaving that role is not betrayal.
Ask whose unlived life you are still performing.
41. Is living away from Kathmandu a wound or part of the design?
Mostly design: work and inner growth away from the birthplace. Return for love and rites, not to become the unnamed
child again. Return as an adult with a name, or the old role will close your future.
42. Will I have children?
The chart does not forbid children. It suggests delay, fewer children, or an unusual path (including later or non-typical
routes). Do not force this in Feb-Jul 2027. 2027-28 is kinder. For medical questions, see a doctor, not only an astrologer.
43. Which family role keeps my career closed?
Being the one who makes everyone else comfortable and never asks. Keep loyalty. Drop self-erasure. The career opens
when you disappoint someone once, on purpose, and stay in the room.
G. Health -- patterns, not a diagnosis
44. What should I take seriously, and what is just worry-weather?
Take seriously: head, heat, rushing, stomach, sleep, teeth and joints in this heavy 2025-28 stretch, nerves in this
paperwork year. Get one real checkup and follow it. The heavy sky-weather makes every sensation feel like doom. That
is fear talking. Live in a clinic, not in a symptom forum. This is not a medical diagnosis.

45. What lifestyle is non-negotiable until 2029?
Sleep as a duty. Move your body on a fixed schedule so anger has somewhere to go besides a relationship. Go easy on
alcohol. Eat in a way that does not punish you after stress. Heroics without rest are not bravery.
46. How do my relationships affect my body?
Unsaid anger shows up as stomach, sleep, or 'helpful' sharpness. After a fight, repair with food and rest, not only with
more talking or more fixing of the other person.
47. When are accidents or burnout more likely?
In this whole courage chapter, and especially Feb-Jul 2027, be careful with tools, speed, temper, and fire. Burnout comes
from not sleeping while you 'push through'. Ordinary care (sleep, seatbelt, no angry driving) matters more than a lucky
stone.
48. Are sleep, drinking, and endless revising spiritual -- or a leak?
They can be either. Planned solitude and real sleep are strength. Alcohol, scrolling, and 'one more revision' with no end
time are a leak. If a habit has no closing time, it is a leak.
H. Mind and choices
49. Where do I get in my own way the most?
You get a clear hit -- say it, send it, choose -- then you cancel it. The cover story is 'I'll do it properly later.' That sentence
is the trap. Next time: one 20-minute action in the same hour. Then do not reverse.
50. Do I over-research until the moment dies?
Yes. Three sources, then decide. A fourth source is usually fear wearing a studious face.
51. When is 'being careful' actually fear of being seen?
Careful is: one review of a contract, a checkup, a savings buffer. Fear of being seen is: 90% done forever, no prices
published, no proposal, changing the subject when someone praises you.
52. When should I act the same day, and when should I wait 72 hours?
Same day: sending a rate, applying, naming what you want, booking something you already researched. Wait 72 hours:
marriage stamp, debt, emigration, surgery, giving someone legal power. If you reverse those two rules, you will live the
unhelpful version of this chart.
53. What do I call duty that is only people-pleasing?
Being useful so nobody frowns. Real duty for you is a named contribution that also pays and sits on a principle. If you
would still do it with no applause, it may be duty. If you only do it so they will like you, it is approval-seeking.
54. Why do I raise the bar or vanish after a win?
Success never feels clean enough, and being seen feels unsafe. Before you start, write what 'done' means. When a result
arrives, do not raise the bar for 24 hours. Let yourself have the win. Then rest. Then the next piece of work.
I. Remedies and action
55. Which remedies actually match me?
Move your body on a schedule. Sleep and keep accounts. Keep your word in partnership. Finish one document instead of
collecting mantras. Price your work. A stone 'for marriage' while ignoring 2027-28 will not marry you. Strengthening
already-strong fire without a physical outlet can just make you hotter. The calendar is the main remedy.
56. If I only do three things until 2028, what three?
1) Train or practise a craft 4+ days a week, not optional. 2) A sleep deadline and a written monthly money account. 3) A
public price or named offer, drafted now, published by July 2027.

57. What will a gemstone not fix?
Backing out after the impulse. The need to sleep and keep accounts. The need to file the paper. The 2027-28 window. A
gym, a calendar, and a contract will do what a ring cannot.
58. Should I already pick wedding or launch dates in 2027-28?
Mark the season: 20 July 2027 to 18 September 2028. Then ask a human astrologer for three candidate days inside it. Do
not pick a wedding from a moon app. Avoid Feb-Jul 2027 for the stamp.
J. The last questions
59. What should I do in the next 90 days?
Before 13 September 2026: tell yourself one career or relationship truth. Do not send it in anger. Until 6 November:
collect options, do not sign. From 6 November to 24 December: negotiate and write it down -- job, practice, or a serious
relationship talk. After that: file, save, sleep. Get a real checkup. Draft the offer you will publish in 2027.
60. What would make this reading a waste?
Waiting until 2029 to feel ready. Marrying a person with no spine, or marrying a project. Staying the unnamed helper.
Starting in the Feb-Jul 2027 cut-window what you should start in July 2027. Endless revision. Asking for more
predictions instead of doing the 20-minute action.
61. When should I see an astrologer again, and what should I bring?
January 2027 (before the cut-window) with real options. June 2027 to pick dates for the harvest season. Bring this file,
actual job offers, the other person's birth data if matching, medical facts not internet fears, and a one-page list of what
you actually did since last time.
62. What question am I not asking that my chart is shouting?
Not 'When do I get a wife, job, or house?' The real question is: will you live a named life, or will you keep being the
hidden engine of other people's success? By 18 September 2028, what will have your name on it? If you cannot answer
in one sentence, that is the work of this year.
IF YOU ONLY REMEMBER FIVE THINGS
1) Until Feb 2027: write it down; first no, then yes. 2) Feb-Jul 2027: endings, not weddings. 3) Jul 2027-Sep 2028: take
the harvest. 4) The trap is 'I'll do it properly later.' 5) Sleep, a body practice, and a named offer beat a lucky stone.
Same nativity as the detailed file. Wording simplified on purpose. Not medical, legal, or financial advice.
